name: Search quality rater – English (Canada) (Welo Data / Welocalize)
summary: Freelance, remote role rating search-engine results for relevance and quality, for people located in Canada working 10–20 hours a week.
whatYouDo: You review search queries and results and give subjective and objective ratings following the client's guidelines. Before starting you complete learning modules and pass a client-designed quality test.
appeal: Official posting specifically for people located in Canada
Set your own schedule within 10–20 hours a week
No rating background needed (past ads-rating experience actually disqualifies you)
watchOuts: Pay is 'up to $15 gross per hour' and may vary with task complexity; currency not stated in what we saw
Must sign an NDA and pass learning modules plus a client exam before earning
You may have to work only on this rating program, not other search/ads rating programs
Posting date not confirmed; reposted listings may be an ongoing talent pipeline rather than a live opening

training.notes: Learning modules and a client-designed quality test before work; whether this time is paid was not stated.

compensation.notes: Official Lever posting: up to $15 gross per hour, varying with task complexity. Currency not shown in the snippet.

reliability.notes: Posting sets a 10–20 hr/week band; no evidence on actual task supply.

applicationSteps: Submit interest through the Welo careers/Lever posting and answer project questions
Complete the skills and language assessment on Welo's platform
Sign the NDA and complete learning modules
Pass the client's quality test, then start rating
fitsIf: You know Canadian culture and current events well and want a steady-ish 10–20 hour weekly side gig.
notFitIf: You already do or want to do other search/ads rating work, or need well above $15/hr.
